subject: Staged OEM quote + cloud-bridge plan for StarForge deal (DEAL-4579)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@starforge.ai>, procurement@starforge.ai
Cc: olga_petrov, karthik_iyer
Date: 2028-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: staged OEM quote + cloud backfill plan for StarForge deal (DEAL-4579)

Emily / StarForge procurement —

Following up on the onboarding call: we need a formal staged-fulfillment proposal that maps to our anticipated ramp for DEAL-4579. High-level asks below, attached a sizing worksheet (dedicated-capacity-sizing-v1.xlsx) with our expected SKU mix. Please reply with:

- Line-item quote by SKU (A100-80, A100-40 equiv, inferred rack counts)
- Lead time per SKU and earliest ship windows (partial shipments allowed)
- Express lane pricing and capacity for compressed delivery (if available)
- MOQ and price breaks tied to quarter-based commitments
- Substitution policy if a specific SKU is delayed
- Suggested milestone billing schedule for staged delivery

Key constraints: we need the first tranche in ~8–10 weeks for an early customer onramp, remainder can be 12–16 weeks. We will evaluate cloud backfill (Reserved instances / short-term committed cloud) to cover shortfalls but want visibility into firm OEM ETA bands so we can plan mixing.

Please attach a PDF quote and any terms you require. If there are recommended bridging partners (cloud or OEM cross-ships), include contact or indicative pricing.

Thanks — would like a draft by end of week so we can align procurement and engineering.

Marcus Lin
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0112

Attachments: dedicated-capacity-sizing-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Emily Chen <emily@starforge.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@starforge.ai, Javier Morales <javier@starforge-svcs.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: staged OEM quote + cloud backfill plan for StarForge deal (DEAL-4579)

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the clear spec and the sizing sheet. Please find attached our proposal (SF-Quote-v2.pdf). TL;DR: we can support a staged ship with the following summary:

- SKU mix proposal: 60% 80-GPU racks (A100-large equivalent), 40% 40-GPU racks (A100-mid).
- Standard lead time: 12–14 weeks from PO for full racks.
- Staged/partial ship: initial tranche (up to 30% of total) in 6–8 weeks if purchase order + 30% deposit is accepted.
- Express lane option: 6–8 week full fulfillment at +18% premium, subject to supply at time of order.
- Substitution: we can substitute equivalent performance SKUs with 7-day notice and price parity; advanced notice required for firmware/configuration changes.
- Warranty & RMA: 12 months standard, extended options available.

We recommend a milestone billing tied to shipment windows. For cloud-bridge recommendations: we have existing handoffs with Nimbus Cloud (Nimbus) and PrimeCloud for short-term reserved capacity; I’ve included Javier from our services group to provide expedited connector contacts.

If the 6–8 week initial tranche is acceptable, we’ll issue a PO-ready quote and a DocuSign link for the staged contract.

Emily Chen
Sales Operations | StarForge Hardware
emily@starforge.ai
+1 (206) 555-4421

Attachments: SF-Quote-v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov, karthik_iyer
Cc: Emily Chen <emily@starforge.ai>, procurement@starforge.ai
Date: 2028-07-22T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: staged OEM quote + cloud backfill plan for StarForge deal (DEAL-4579)

Looping you both in — Emily sent a workable quote (attached). Two immediate risks to triage before we commit:

1) Lead-time exposure: initial tranche 6–8 weeks is borderline but acceptable if we accept a smaller first delivery. We need clarity on guaranteed ship windows (not ranges) and penalties for missed tranche dates.
2) SKU substitution & performance parity: if they substitute a GPU SKU, we need engineering signoff to ensure latency/cost targets hold.
3) Budget cadence: express lane premium (18%) is material; we should decide whether to reserve a small express buffer for top-tier customers.

Proposed next steps (please action):
- Olga: can procurement accept staggered invoicing with 30% deposit? Can we get a 30-day SLA for penalties or credits if a tranche misses a date? Please review attached term sheet and propose edits.
- Karthik: run a quick perf/cost delta on the proposed substitution paths (A100-large -> A100-mid equivalence) and advise whether our QoS can be preserved with software tuning.
- Emily / StarForge: can you provide a firm ship calendar (week-level) and confirm whether Nimbus or PrimeCloud bridging options include committed short-term reserved pricing?

If we can lock the calendar and substitution guardrails, I’m comfortable moving forward with a PO for the initial tranche.

Marcus

Date: 2028-07-24T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: staged OEM quote + cloud backfill plan for StarForge deal (DEAL-4579)

Marcus / team —

Reviewed StarForge’s PDF. Procurement is fine with staged invoicing and 30% deposit for the initial tranche provided we include:

- A clear shipment schedule (week-level) in the contract appendix.
- A substitution clause limited to "form-factor and performance parity" with pre-approved fallback SKUs; substitutions that change power/thermal profiles require 14-day engineering notice and no additional cost.
- Penalty structure: 5% credit per missed tranche week (capped at 15% of tranche value) if delay is not force majeure.
- Escrow for firmware images during transition.

I attached a procurement-term-sheet.docx with edits and a suggested milestone invoice schedule. We should also request a single point of escalation and a named account manager for logistics.

Olga Petrov
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

Attachments: procurement-term-sheet.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily@starforge.ai>
Cc: procurement@starforge.ai
Date: 2028-07-28T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: staged OEM quote + cloud backfill plan for StarForge deal (DEAL-4579)

Thanks — quick update from engineering and final asks before PO: 

- Perf delta: initial perf estimate shows a 7–11% latency increase if a mid-SKU is substituted for 20% of the fleet, but cost/kg improves ~9%. We can absorb this with tuning for non-latency-sensitive routes; for p99-sensitive customers we should earmark express-lane capacity.
- Thermal/power: substitutions flagged by Olga are acceptable but need a depot-level config push (we estimate 2 business days per tranche to validate).

Final asks for StarForge to confirm so procurement can issue PO:
1) Firm week-level ship dates for tranche 1 and tranche 2 (we’ll include them in DocuSign).
2) A substitution notification window of at least 7 days with an articulated substitute SKU and perf matrix.
3) Agreement to the penalty credit (5%/week capped at 15% non-FM).
4) Confirmation that Nimbus bridging contacts (if used) will reserve short-term committed capacity for up to 8 weeks, with pricing estimates.

Emily / Javier: please confirm the above and we’ll route the DocuSign contract (link below) for signatures. Happy to fast-track as soon as we have firm calendar.

-- Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
